traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets imagination and idealism. Heightened sensitivity, imagination, and a pull toward the ideal. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Imaginative and compassionate; creative and charitable directions come naturally. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize selfhood and imagination into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what selfhood and imagination have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Creative or service-oriented directions; guard against self-deception and being played.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
base: An intuitive or creative idea becomes easier to trust once it can survive one practical test outside the imagination.

readerCopy.body: An intuitive or creative idea becomes easier to trust once it can survive one practical test outside the imagination. When the Sun sextiles Neptune, purpose and imagination cooperate, helping inspiration take a form that can be seen, shared, or evaluated. A draft, sketch, prototype, conversation, or hour of focused work can reveal more than waiting for certainty. The vision earns confidence by meeting ordinary conditions, not by remaining perfect in theory.
